MYTHOS ENHANCEMENTS BUG FIXES (Apr 7, 17:00):

Three bugs found and fixed in ~/.hermes/plugins/distillation/mythos_enhancements.py:

BUG 1: Cycle info never reached pre_llm_call. on_pre_llm_call_enhanced() called build_adaptive_context(user_message) without passing cycle_info. The _last_cycle_info stored on the module by post_tool_call was never read by pre_llm_call.
FIX: on_pre_llm_call_enhanced now reads _last_cycle_info from both function attr and module attr, passes to build_adaptive_context.

BUG 2: Behavior calibration only persisted non-productive calls. Productive calls just incremented in-memory counter that resets each session. behavior_calibration table stayed empty.
FIX: Productive calls now sampled (~50% via hash prefix check) and recorded to behavior_calibration table.

BUG 3: Duplicate cycle info storage in __init__.py was conflicting with internal storage.
FIX: Simplified __init__.py hook to just call on_post_tool_call_enhanced() — the module now handles all state internally.

ALL THREE FIXES VERIFIED with end-to-end test showing:
- Cycle detection → intervention injection working
- Behavior calibration recording all 3 types (productive/insufficient/redundant)
- Adaptive context showing both cycle alerts and behavior corrections
